tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search Glitchwire's full article archive (title + excerpt, newest first). Returns matching articles with title, url, markdown_url, excerpt, categories, date, author.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Get Glitchwire's most recent articles, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one Glitchwire article as clean, ad-free markdown (includes title, date, author, source URL, and full body). Use the slug from search_news / latest_news results.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Glitchwire's technology news archive. Returns results as {results:[{id,title,url}]}; pass an id to fetch for the full article.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a Glitchwire article by id (from search) as {id,title,text,url,metadata}.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
